Strategy: Log-ratio pairing preference. Score each bin by the absolute log-ratio between its residual and twice the item size, preferring a leftover gap near that target. The choice differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest fit leaves a residual far from twice the item while a looser bin leaves a gap near it. It may help by creating reusable same-size gaps with scale-free penalties, but may fail if future items differ greatly in size.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(log(r) - log(2 * item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Lower-half worst-fit: loosest bin at/below midrange; upper half penalized below all lower bins.
